concept: DMS: DB migration with CDC and minimal downtime
tests: Choosing a service to migrate a production DB with continuous change replication until cutover.
expected: AWS DMS with ongoing replication: full load + CDC, near-zero-downtime cutover. Triggers: "minimal downtime", "continuously replicating changes until cutover".
why_not: Snowball is offline bulk transfer, not live replication; Transfer Acceleration speeds up S3 uploads; mysqldump/import requires long downtime.
